tickets.title: Project is a hub with one page per section
tickets.what:
spec items 1, 4 and 6 with today's data. `MonitorState` gets the open Project page; the hub
renders the summary rows; Progress, Tickets, Working tree, Docs and Control plane become pages that render today's
sections (Progress and Tickets unchanged for now; 03 redoes them). Esc/`‹` returns to the hub; per-page cursor and
scroll survive reload; Home's progress block opens Progress, a Home ticket row opens Tickets. Help and
docs/reference(.zh).md describe the hub.

**Size:** about 300 source lines, project-page tests and frames updated

acceptance.text: Hub at 40/80/120 columns EN/ZH, unicode and text icons (frames regenerated with `npm run snapshots:update`)
Enter opens each page, Esc and the crumb return; Tab/`1`/`2` keep switching Home ⇄ Project
Page, cursor and scroll survive a panel reload
Home's progress Enter lands on Progress; a ticket row on Tickets
Collection still runs only while a Project page is visible

tickets.title: The project collector supplies ledger history, live jobs, ticket detail and the project list
tickets.what:
data only, in `src/collectors/project-board.ts` (and `src/roles/projects.ts` for the list); no
rendering. `ProjectSnapshot` gains:
- `ledger: { id, state, milestone, text, commit?, at? }[]` for every `## Slices` row in file order; `commit` is the
  last 7–40 hex token in the row; `at` (ms) from one batched `git log --no-walk --format=%h%x00%ct` through the
  existing safe Git path and five-second gate, only on full collection; unknown hashes get no `at`;
- `active: { jobId, role, state, package?, title?, at?, asking }[]`: HUD jobs from the existing newest-64 lookup whose
  cwd is inside the project root and whose state has not settled;
- per ticket `items: { done: boolean, text: string }[]` (its checklist) and `comment?: string` (the last bullet under
  `## Comments`, whitespace-joined, at most 600 characters);
- `projectList(hudHome, panelRoot): { root, name }[]`: panel root first, then `projects.json` roots that exist,
  realpath-deduplicated, at most 16; missing or bad file → only the panel root.
The collector already takes a cwd; keep it usable for any listed root. Today's fields stay as they are.

**Size:** about 200 source lines; tests in a new
`tests/unit/project-data.test.mjs` (do not edit project-page.test.mjs or the frames: 01 owns them)

Legacy role: agy-imp (gemini-4-hydrogen-high)

acceptance.text: Ledger rows with milestone, commit and date on a synthetic git repo; a row without a hash has no date
Active jobs: only unsettled jobs under the root; settled and other-root jobs excluded
Ticket items and latest comment parsed; no comment section → no `comment`
projectList: order, dedupe, missing dirs dropped, bad file tolerated
Home-mode collection reads nothing new; Git still gated

tickets.title: Progress page, ticket detail and the project switch
tickets.what:
spec items 2, 3 and 5 on top of 01's pages and 02's data. Progress: Now / Next / To try / Done as
the feature spec says, two-line rows at narrow widths, folding per milestone. Tickets: feature meters, ticket
detail (checklist and latest comment) inside the panel, `o` to the editor. Switch: the hub's top row names the
project; `[` / `]` cycle `projectList`; the panel keeps one collector per visited root (at most 4, oldest dropped);
the choice survives reload; Home unchanged. Help, reference (en/zh) and docs/releases/0.1.3.md.

**Size:** about 400 source lines, project-page tests and frames updated

acceptance.text: Progress shows what is in flight, what to try and what was done at 40/80/120 EN/ZH
Ticket detail shows checklist and comment; `o` opens the file
Switching projects changes every page; Home stays on the panel's project; a project without STATE.md works
The choice survives reload; collection only for the shown project

tickets.title: A projects list above the hub when there are several projects
tickets.what:
feature spec item 7: the hub's name row `name ▾ i/n` opens a Projects list (two rows per project,
ordered panel project → waiting → running → recent), Enter opens that project's hub, Esc/`‹` returns; `2` opens the
last shown project's hub; one project shows no list. A light per-project overview in the collector (STATE, tickets,
active job count; signature-cached; no Git, no roles); full collection only for the shown project. EN/ZH, 40/80/120.

**Size:** about 250 source lines, frames regenerated

acceptance.text: Several projects: list rows with milestone, `?` waiting, `◉` running, bar, last activity; order as specified
One project: no list, nothing changes
Enter/Esc/`‹` and `2` behave as specified through real input; choice survives reload
The list collection reads no Git and re-reads only changed files
